securityNotes: Do not restore the old NPC artwork policy; the fog/collision release already installed observed-token Storage authorization.
Fog-enabled movement previews cannot reveal tool/token coordinates; database collision remains authoritative.
Existing test campaigns only; do not create paid preview/development resources.
Macro quickcode helper is private, numeric-only, limited to an already authorized character/NPC macro source and keeps the strict server dice validator.
Movement fog presentation only reuses previously visible and explored artwork: authorized visible remains empty during RPC refresh; no hidden token or new unexplored content is revealed.

Hotbar roll drag payloads carry only validated IDs/action references, never raw sensitive character sheet records; invoking sheet actions checks campaign and source ownership and weapon/spell/initiative RPCs keep server authorization.
Consolidated approved release #45 is based on production #42; Supabase migration 20261107173054 was successfully applied and post-verified before the GitHub merge. No paid infrastructure.
World Runtime RPC grants checked: anon denied, authenticated authorized; forge_visibility remains private, preview rate table RLS enabled.
Authenticated SQL smoke-tested valid owned token, unauthorized foreign token, denied DM bypass, and reversible DM trajectory; all tests in rollback transactions.

Cross-inventory transfers: SQL candidate (not applied) separately authorizes owned character and shared/owned issued tool, requires active source-item lease and checks contiguous destination space. Staged frontend must not be released before its matching RPC.

Movement continuity: older fog ticks are ignored ONLY when a server-confirmed frame already covers that revision and the fog mode matches; newly invalidated sight remains fail-closed. All RLS, collision, and observer-preview SQL stay unchanged.

PR #52: migration 20261108091818 installed RLS-restricted per-viewer revision table; anon denied and authenticated SELECT-only, v2 RPC authenticated-only; private helper grants withheld; deployed client pending single main release.
A03: historical applied anon GRANT cleanup has missing source migration parity (issue #69); this is documentation follow-up E05, NOT permission to reapply SQL.

A02: PR #71 may retain previously authorized renderer sight during indefinitely pending observer resync; require bounded deadline, stream-locked movement input gating, tests, targeted metadata refresh and final green CI before merge.

A04: manual authenticated DM+two-player fixture contract staged only. Do not run live fixture writes or record player identities, invite codes, JWTs, signed media URLs or unrevealed NPC data in public test evidence.

A05: browser trace opt-in ?worldV2Trace=1 keeps only 256 bounded allowlisted events/duration samples per metric and no secret IDs, RPC payloads or coordinates. No extra network logging or telemetry service. Counter results are not substitute for RLS security acceptance.

A06: no role/permission/visibility regression was directly tested with authenticated players, and the current test map's fog/collision are disabled. Database historical execution figures cannot establish observer confidentiality or renderer flash root cause.

B08: nonapplied Commit SQL preserves canonical write authority; no paid services or new public grants. Hide-priority under saturated B07 FIFO and no-trigger terminal drain remain release blockers; no real fog/Auth test.

B08 B07-FIFO amendment: private hidden-piece queues preempt old unsent paths with a certified hide, preserving other-piece FIFO. Isolated SQL pass only; free-tier budget delay and real LOS revocation still B10 blockers.

B09 staged frontend only: mixed-group selection is fail-closed; keyboard continuation requires new authorized sight; second touch cancels drag; DM player preview stays nonpersistent. No live browser or Auth/LOS verification.

B10 NO-GO: live catalog confirms B03 validator not installed/wired, B07/B08 queues absent; public advance authenticated-only and private forge_world_v2 usage denied. Source-real PG17 coexistence is not a production migration.

B10: PR #71 unamended, budget exhaustion eventual private observer recovery unproven; CodeQL staging scan successful on earlier head, 24 authenticated DM/P1/P2 scenarios NOT RUN. No merge/deploy/SQL approval.
B10 CI: serial 823-test npm test suite and single startup-only Chrome CDP retry; a failed browser assertion remains failed. This is not live authenticated UX validation.

B10-R01 candidate routes fresh private Core advances through B03, preserving B08 exact replay and restricted private function grants. Source-real isolated tests passed; live RPC remains ORIGINAL and unmodified.

B10-R02: default-off authenticated six-second vision fallback can recover canonical visible positions/hides when private Realtime budget loses all packets, with signed roster/cursor gates; browser offline/background and ambiguous same-origin deferred frames prevent hard guarantees. Gate B NO-GO.

Fixture is NOT ready for live execution until a controlled test campaign has required fog/collision/lights/roles prepared. PR #74 is bounded client tracing only, stacked on PR #73 and PR #72. It cannot independently deploy, and runtime performance cannot be inferred from CI until authorized three-session testing in A06. PR #75 documents the partial A06 baseline; authenticated DM/P1/P2 browser measurements and protected fixture prep remain BLOCKED. No approval for deployment or SQL is implied. Do not advance to Gate A or B01 before completing A06 or separately approved deviation.
